historical_exposure: 2022H2-2023 outcomes were viewed in other strategy families; this candidate-conditioned policy result is retrospective, not untouched OOS. No threshold changes are allowed after evaluation.
hypothesis: A stock that trades below its minimum low from the five immediately preceding XTKS sessions but closes back above that support in the top quartile of its signal-day range may reflect a failed breakdown and short-term demand absorption.

candidate_pool.universe: Rows from the frozen Yahoo daily OHLCV feature panel; only internally valid positive-volume daily bars are actionable.
candidate_pool.support: Signal-day low is strictly below the minimum low of the five immediately preceding official XTKS sessions; signal-day close is strictly above that minimum.
candidate_pool.rejection_quality: (close-low)/(high-low) >= 0.75; zero-range or incomplete five-session history is ineligible.

score_and_selection.score: Equal-weight mean of signal-day close location and (close - prior-five-session-low)/(high-low).
score_and_selection.daily_selection: Score descending; at most 5 symbols per XTKS session. Include up to five available candidates; abstain if none.
score_and_selection.cooldown: Suppress the same symbol on the immediately following official XTKS session after selection; only selected rows update cooldown state.

target: Signal-date OHLCV determines the setup. Enter at next official XTKS session open and exit at close of the fifth official XTKS session including entry; return is exit close / entry open - 1.

periods.2024: Closed; no candidate family result may be selected or tuned from it.
periods.2026: Report-only; closed to selection and tuning.

gates_each_discovery_period.net_0_5pct: mean > 0, median > 0, win_rate > 0.50, mean excluding top3 winners > 0
gates_each_discovery_period.downside_vs_full_candidate_pool: -10% and -20% rates no higher than full candidate pool on the same dates
gates_each_discovery_period.monthly_robustness: At least half of resolved selection months have positive net mean.
gates_each_discovery_period.complete_daily_cohorts: At least 20 complete days with positive net mean, median, and mean excluding top3 winners.
gates_each_discovery_period.family_decision: Both 2022H2 and 2023 must pass every gate. Otherwise REJECT; no replacement feature, cutoff, or ranking is tested.

costs.note: 0.5% is a sensitivity assumption, not measured execution cost.
